messages:
jordana_cs: Morning team 1: Thistledown private VPC cutover tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need final signoff on: CIDR block, IAM provisioning ARNs, customer CMK policy, and audit log sink (they want GCP SIEM). Any last-minute blockers?
tariq_se: I reviewed their runbook. CIDR conflict check: their infra uses 10.0.0.0/16 and 10.1.0.0/16. Propose Redwood uses 10.30.0.0/16 for Thistledown.
eva_net: 10.30.0.0/16 is fine. Posting route table export and ACLs to s3://redwood-internal/thistledown/routes-1745001234.json.
sam_ops: On audit logs: Thistledown wants push to a GCP Pub/Sub subscription. They require JWT auth and 3rd-party cert pinning. We can either publish directly with a service account or they can host a forwarder in their VPC. Which do they prefer?
tariq_se: For KMS: they said they will provide a customer-managed CMK ARN and want explicit grant to arn:aws:iam::888888888888:role/redwood-provisioner for kms:Encrypt and kms:Decrypt. If they refuse cross-account grants, we will need kms:CreateGrant for the provisioning window.\ej: sorry wrong handle
jordana_cs: tagging thistledown-ops to decide egress: direct pubsub vs forwarder. Also need CMK ARN and key policy pasted here.
thistledown-ops: prefer direct Pub/Sub. We'll create a service account: thistledown-logs@thistledown-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com and grant pubsub.publisher. Will upload SA JSON key to secure bucket.
eva_net: if direct pubsub, we need the SA email and a short-lived key or IAM binding. Also note our NAT egress IPs if they need allowlisting: [52.14.77.101, 52.14.77.102].
sam_ops: confirmed we can accept JWT bearer for Pub/Sub. They should upload SA key to s3://redwood-internal/thistledown/sa-key.enc and provide access 1: owner: thistledown-ops 1: due: today EOD.
tariq_se: posted IAM snippet they can copy for minimal key policy.
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {
      "Sid":"AllowRedwoodProvisioner",
      "Effect":"Allow",
      "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::888888888888:role/redwood-provisioner"},
      "Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:CreateGrant"],
      "Resource":"*"
    }
  ]
}
```
jordana_cs: Action items recap:
- thistledown-ops: upload SA key or confirm forwarder + provide hostname 1: due today 18:00 PT.
- thistledown-sec: paste CMK ARN and key policy or accept cross-account grants 1: due today 18:00 PT.
- eva_net: provide final NAT IPs and route table diff 1: due today 16:00 PT.
- tariq_se: prepare failover runbook if CMK unavailable during cutover 1: due today 19:00 PT.

sam_ops: scheduling dry-run at 09:00 PT tomorrow, cutover 10:00 PT. I'll have Jordan (SRE) and Priya (oncall) on calls.

integrations-bot: precheck complete for thistledown-cutover at 1745005000. Status: WARNINGS: none. Connectivity check: NAT IPs reachable, pubsub endpoint resolvable. See https://ci.redwood.ai/reports/thistledown/precheck-1745005000

jordana_cs: Good. One risk note: if their CMK rotates or policy is changed within 24h of cutover, this could extend to >8h remediation and impact renewal conversation. I'll trigger renewal ops if we hit >8h unresolved.
thistledown-ops: will avoid key rotation within 48h of cutover. See you at dry-run.
jordana_cs: thanks everyone 1: will post post-cutover feedback thread for enablement gaps.
